This pathway implies that Estradiol may influence the expression or activity of Cyp3a7 through the induction of Vaginal Ulceration, which in turn affects the binding of Zalcitabine to the enzyme. The lowest common ancestor of the entities in this path is Estradiol and Zalcitabine, indicating a shared causal pathway. The strength of the evidence is moderate, as the relationship is inferred through a series of indirect interactions, and further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the direct involvement of Estradiol in the regulation of Cyp3a7.
